title: Great pan, horrible lid
text: Great pan, horrible lid. The pan itself is fine.  It's the lid. My first lid broke over medium heat, 5 minutes in, though after yers is use.  I thought, okay, this is a fluke.  Got my second pan/cover. Was terrified if using the lid, so used aluminum foil instead.  Realized a couple days ago I was being ridiculous.  Used the lid.  2x. 2nd time, it wasn’t even on the pan.  It was sitting next to it, on medium heat.  Broke.  All those shards now under my burners,  it took me a year to get the nerve to use it and two uses to kill it.  The pan is great, the cover is the devil.
